instruction: Please help set GIMP's undo history size to 64 levels.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's undo history size to 64 levels via Edit > Preferences > Environment. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (undo-levels 64) using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the GIMP config file from the standard location (~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc)
Metric correctly parses gimprc S-expression format and checks for the specific key-value pair (undo-levels 64)
Expected value correctly specifies 'undo-levels' with value '64' matching GIMP's config format
Postconfig ensures settings are flushed to disk by closing GIMP before evaluation
Complete coverage of the instruction requirement (set undo history to 64 levels)
Parameter handling is correct - metric receives rules dict directly, not wrapped in type/rules structure
